S3/Athena cần thêm giao nhận và cấu hình schema.
Logs Insights có thể tự phát hiện trường log JSON.

references.title: Set up CloudWatch logging for REST APIs in API Gateway
references.quote: Access logging – You log who accessed your API and how.
references.supports: Access logging cung cấp dữ liệu về access pattern.

references.title: Access logging for REST APIs
references.quote: you select $context variables, a log format, and a log group destination.
references.supports: Access log được cấu hình theo stage, gửi tới log group CloudWatch Logs.

references.title: Analyzing log data with CloudWatch Logs Insights
references.quote: any application or custom log that emits log events as JSON.
references.supports: Logs Insights tự discover field của log JSON (không cần tự parse).

references.title: Logging Amazon API Gateway API calls using AWS CloudTrail
references.section: API Gateway management events in CloudTrail
references.quote: Amazon API Gateway logs all API Gateway actions as management events, except for TestInvokeAuthorizer and TestInvokeMethod.
references.supports: CloudTrail ghi các action quản lý của API Gateway, không phải request tới API.

references.title: Log REST API calls to Amazon Data Firehose in API Gateway
references.quote: For access logging, you can only enable CloudWatch or Firehose—you can't enable both.
references.supports: Access log chỉ đi CloudWatch Logs hoặc Firehose; S3 cần thêm Firehose.

references.title: Execution logging for REST APIs
references.section: Amazon CloudWatch Logs delivery for execution logs
references.quote: You choose the destination: your own CloudWatch Logs log groups, Amazon S3 buckets, or Firehose streams.
references.supports: Chỉ execution log (không phải access log) mới có đích S3 trực tiếp qua CloudWatch Logs delivery.

references.title: Amazon API Gateway dimensions and metrics
references.quote: API Gateway will not send these metrics unless you have explicitly enabled detailed CloudWatch metrics.
references.supports: Detailed metrics chỉ là metric theo method/resource/stage, không có thông tin caller.

references.title: Execution logging for REST APIs
references.quote: You cannot choose the log group name or send logs directly to Amazon S3 or Firehose.
references.supports: Standard logging không gửi thẳng S3; đích S3 cần cơ chế bổ sung (C tốn công hơn).
